book: Latin polemical treatise on the Lord's Supper, 'Syntagma universae de sacrosancta coena Domini controversiae' (1560), a single work by Abdias Liberinus in argued sections, with a numbered series of answers (AD I-XVI) to the adversary's arguments inside an Animadversio part, which appears twice on the sheet.
